title: Senior Product Manager, Analytics Platform
description:
ClarityBI is a Series C B2B SaaS company building embedded analytics and reporting tools for mid-market and enterprise software vendors. Our platform lets SaaS companies ship world-class analytics dashboards directly inside their own products. We're hiring a Senior PM to own our core analytics product.

About the role:
- Own the roadmap for our embeddable analytics and reporting surface
- Work closely with engineering on data pipeline architecture and query performance
- Partner with enterprise customers to understand how they need to expose data to their end users
- Define pricing tiers and packaging for our analytics add-on module
- Collaborate with Sales Engineers and Solutions Consultants on enterprise deals

What we're looking for:
- 6+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS
- Experience building customer-facing analytics, reporting, or BI products — not just using analytics tools internally
- Strong data fluency: you understand query engines, data modeling, and can partner credibly with data engineers
- Experience at a company with $75M+ ARR — you understand what it means to manage a product at enterprise scale
- You have owned a pricing or packaging decision for a product or feature tier
- Remote OK, US-based

Nice to have:
- Background in BI tooling, data infrastructure, or developer-facing data products
- Experience with embedded analytics patterns (white-labeling, multi-tenant data isolation)
- Prior experience in a platform or SDK product

Comp: $175k-$210k + equity
